source_text.slice: REQ-517 slice 2a (grant admin plane), GH #2535, decision 0051 stage 2. 2b (route classes, stored on, Authorize enforcement, attachment-link audit, shadow counters AC 22) is NOT in this change.

task.description: Implement PR 2a of the REQ-517 design. No tests written; nothing committed or pushed.

result.summary: 2a implemented. MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean. mix format --check-formatted: clean. mix letflow.check_boundaries: 0 violations (1696 edges). mix letflow.check_role_scope_grants_writers: no violations on the real tree; ad-hoc audit() probe flagged Repo.insert_all of the schema, Multi.delete_all, raw DELETE FROM, struct literal, and RoleScopeGrant.changeset, and passed the verbatim RoleScopeGrants.delete_group_principal_rows! pair. MIX_ENV=dev mix letflow.permission_matrix --check: needed --baseline-ref HEAD~1 because the baseline equals HEAD on an uncommitted tree (plain --check raises baseline_is_head); with it result=pass, core matrix changes none, golden file untouched. NOT RUN: mix test (forbidden), mix letflow.check as a whole, migrations against a database.
coordinator_amendments_applied: G1: write_error includes :last_admin_binding_row; delete maps it to typed 409 last_admin_binding_row.

G2: sole remaining row of a (principal, TENANT_ADMIN) set: scoped => last_scoped_row WINS; last_admin_binding_row only when that sole row is tenant_wide and the principal is a group. last_admin_binding_row writes NO tenant_admin.guard_refused event (plain rollback, no guard path).

scope_tenant_admin uses count_explicit_tenant_wide_admins (TenantAdminGuard.count_before!/2 and ensure_admins_remain!/5 with :explicit), per the coordinator amendment, instead of the design 3.9 counted default.

AC 9 self-grant: auth_context carries only the owner user id for an API token (no token id), so 'caller' = auth_context.user_id (the token's owner) and a group the caller is a member of. A token's own id is not available in auth_context; if a separate token principal id must also be refused, the pipeline would have to expose it (not done).
deviations: actor map (ScopedGrants, ServicePrincipal) carries an optional credential string (oidc or api_token) for SEC D-3; design 3.4 typed it as user_id and trace_id only.

RoleScopeGrants.effective?/4 is implemented with its own queries rather than calling the Identity read functions (avoids a RoleScopeGrants -> Identity dependency); Identity has the same-shape reads for ScopedGrants.
Cursor encode/decode lives in ScopedGrants.list/4 (prefix RG:), the router passes the raw cursor string.
ScopeNodePaths.retire reads the node via plain fetch first to keep the idempotent already-retired path unlocked, then locks FOR NO KEY UPDATE and re-checks retired_at before references_node?.

The migration_test :down fix was made in the test (design 3.6.3 and the task asked for it): FK migration rolled back first, scoped grant fixture inserted by SQL, precheck assertion RuntimeError ~r/role_scope_grants fk precheck: 1/ then re-insert nodes and FK :up. The raising assertion (Ecto.Migrator re-raising the RuntimeError unwrapped) is unverified because tests were not run.
notes_for_test_designer: Existing tests that WILL fail or need editing: test/letflow/api/scope_grants_route_walk_test.exs T-RW1b (public function list of RoleScopeGrants now also insert_scoped/5, insert_tenant_wide/4, delete_row!/2, delete_scoped_rows!/4, get_row/2, rows_for/4, references_node?/2, list_page/4, effective?/4) and T-RW1c (scope_node_id params / tenant_wide: false now legal in insert_scoped and the readers); T-RW2c new. test/letflow/api/authorization_enforcement_test.exs: register Letflow.Routers.TenantRoleScopeGrants in @routers and @mount_prefix '/tenant/role-scope-grants'; platform-scope inventory tests via forward regex. Any test pinning the exact list of manifest entries / migration count, and any test asserting TokenPreconditions.findings/1 keys or the token-preconditions body 'information' keys (now also service_principal_owner). Tests that add the TENANT_ADMIN caller to a group through POST /groups/:id/members now get 409 self_grant_refused (grep test/letflow/routers/identity*, test/letflow/identity*). Tests that create a retire on a node and a tests of ScopeNodePaths.write retire are unchanged unless a grant names the node. Any test asserting list_tokens/1 item shape by exact map equality (now has owner_flagged). Any test calling TenantAdminGuard.ensure_admins_remain!/4 or count_before!/1 is unaffected (they delegate with :counted).

G2 test: sole remaining row of a group's TENANT_ADMIN set that is SCOPED => 409 last_scoped_row (not last_admin_binding_row); sole row tenant_wide of the admin group => 409 last_admin_binding_row and NO tenant_admin.guard_refused audit row; the group with 2+ rows deleting the tenant_wide row is allowed subject to revoke_tenant_admin_grant (explicit count).

scope_tenant_admin is unreachable via HTTP (step 8 refuses with tenant_wide_row_exists first): test it at function level with TenantAdminGuard.count_before!(prefix, :explicit) / ensure_admins_remain!(prefix, :scope_tenant_admin, id, before, :explicit) inside a transaction, per the coordinator.

Service-principal route gate order: credential == :oidc, then Scope.require_tenant_wide, then TENANT_ADMIN held tenant-wide; all refusals are the same uniform 403 'insufficient permissions'. Body: extra key or non-boolean/missing flagged => 422 invalid_body (checked before the reason); then reason_required / invalid_reason; unknown or non-UUID user => 404 only after the reason check.

list: 'limit' non-integer or outside 1..200 => 400 'invalid limit'; bad cursor => 400 'invalid cursor'; bad filter value => 422 invalid_principal / invalid_role. Other query params (including tenant) are ignored.

Audit: grant.created/revoked/made_tenant_wide/self_grant_refused and service_principal.flagged/unflagged all carry credential in after_state; grant.revoked after_state is {credential, actor, trace_id} and before_state is the row keys. unflagged carries tokens_exceeding_owner (count). Audit.list_entries has no action filter (finding F8).
ServicePrincipal.set_flag with an unchanged value returns changed false and writes no audit row.
FK migration down uses DO block guarded by to_regclass on both tables; precheck message is 'role_scope_grants fk precheck: <count>'.
Scan fixtures: must-pass fixtures should be the verbatim identity.ex group-principal delete pair and tenant_admin_migration reconcile pair; the whole-word rule is verified by an ad-hoc probe only.
AC 22 (shadow counters) is 2b; nothing for it here.
